text:
FINANCIAL DATA PROTECTION OFFICE FICTIONAL REGULATOR - SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE
Guidance: Records of marketing consent
Notice number: RCN-2026-019
Issued by: Financial Data Protection Office
Published: 2026-11-05
Effective date: 2027-01-01
1. Who this applies to
Any firm that sends electronic marketing to individuals.
2. Background
Firms must be able to show that customers agreed to receive marketing, and stop promptly when they withdraw consent.
3. Requirements
3.1 A firm must keep a record of when and how each customer gave consent to electronic marketing.
3.2 A firm must stop sending electronic marketing within 10 days after a customer withdraws consent.
4. Status
Firms must comply with the requirements in section 3 from 2027-01-01.
Synthetic document written for a Snowflake example. The regulator, rule and numbers are fictional.

obligations.reason: Policy POL-PRV-03 explicitly states "The date, channel and wording of each opt-in are stored in the consent register," which directly satisfies the obligation to keep a record of when and how each customer gave consent to electronic marketing.
